lines.1: The cruiser headed toward the mainland.
lines.2: 「Rest easy. I will not tell anyone about this incident.」
lines.3: 「Of course we won't say anything either.」
lines.4: 「But Principal, you should investigate that island sometime.」
lines.6: 「Konoe saw a figure last night. Someone other than us.」
lines.7: And on top of that, I'd heard an inexplicable explosive boom.
lines.10: Even that tremendous explosive boom made sense if the Principal was behind it.
lines.11: 「Even I have a sense of responsibility. I swam over later to check on you while getting some exercise.」
lines.20: Because of that, I wound up flustered in all sorts of ways.
lines.21: And so our one-night, two-day stay on a deserted island came to an end.
lines.22: It had been eventful, but... yeah, I had fun.
